header: I keep ONE rule for how Yes / No votes on a model-written answer are counted. Both "verified" (learning.ts) and "blocked" (log.ts) use it, so they can never disagree:
* a PERSON counts once per (question, SQL): the same person voting on five asks of the same question is still one voice;
* the LATEST vote of that person wins, so changing your mind (or clicking Undo, which clears the verdict) simply replaces the earlier vote;
* rows with no user (votes from before sign-in was required) count together as ONE person.
Parameter $1 of any query that embeds this must be the normalized question.
